comments.text:
Great video my friend
One small correction tho...
Dunvegan is pronounced like  "dOnvegan"
Its 2hrs east of fort st john or rocky mtn fort.
My dear departed wife and i use to go over there alot and locals say its haunted but we never ever seen or experienced anything...
🤟

replies.author: @HiddenCanada
replies.text: Thanks for the correction, I really appreciate it. I definitely got the pronunciation wrong on that one. And I’m sorry to hear about your wife. It sounds like Dunvegan holds some special memories for you both. Interesting too that with all the stories locals tell about the place, you never experienced anything unusual there yourselves. Thanks for watching and sharing this.
